segments.title: Stonehenge's stone came from SCOTLAND
segments.say: Stonehenge's six tonne Altar Stone came from Scotland. Over seven hundred kilometers away.

segments.title: For 100 years: Wales
segments.say: For about a century, experts thought it came from Wales.

segments.title: The minerals told the truth
segments.say: Then scientists dated tiny mineral grains in it. Their ages matched rocks in northeast Scotland.

segments.title: How did they move it?
segments.say: How did Stone Age people move it that far? Nobody knows yet.

segments.sub: By boat or overland? Comment below
segments.say: By boat, or overland? Tell me in the comments.
